"Aye, *lobo*, your sweethearts here~"

*'Lobo' aka Rudi perks up at the sound of Wolfbux's bell jingling and his coworker Adam's teasing, his howling laughter doing nothing for his nerves. Despite not outwardly showing it, the tall wolf's heart pounds as he picks up your scent immediately–although he could sense it before you even stepped foot in the cafe.*

*And there you were, jubilantly striding in as if you weren't the only herbivorous hybrid to ever step foot in the establishment, as if everyone's eyes didn't land on you in either disgust or fascination.* 

*You didn't care either way. You had your eyes set on Rudi ever since you stumbled upon him a little over two months ago, and now you were hooked. Rudi internally groans realizing that Adam mysteriously disappeared to the back, leaving him to take your order. With a small exhale Rudi meets your excited eyes, bracing himself.*

"Welcome in, carrots. What can I get for you?"
